text: Real cohesive HoTT is a variant of modal HoTT where cohesion is defined over:
choices: the real numbers ℝ, enabling synthetic differential geometry
explanation: Real-cohesive HoTT (Shulman) uses ℝ-cohesion to do synthetic differential geometry: smooth functions, de Rham cohomology, and Chern-Weil theory all become synthetic.
